title: Siege of Thionville (1792)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Thionville (1792)", at revision 1370745796, opens: "The siege of Thionville saw an unsuccessful attempt to conquer the French stronghold of Thionville by the Austro-royalists during the War of the First Coalition." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3486033, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1792 siege during the War of the First Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
